name: singlet_abundance_hierarchical_composition_test
title: Resolution-robust composition test on a cell-type hierarchy
description: Tests which nodes of a cell-type hierarchy change in relative abundance between conditions, using a tree-aggregated Dirichlet-multinomial model by default. Needs sample and condition labels plus a cluster tree or ordered author labels; optional resolutions add a stability score. Writes node effects and calls, not cell labels. Use abundance.celltype_proportion_test instead when the question is only about predefined leaf types.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

design.description: Sample-level keys that define the sample-by-leaf count table.

sample_key.description: obs column of the independent replicate (donor or library). Required.

condition_key.description: obs column of the sample-level condition being tested. Required.

batch_key.description: Optional obs column of a sample-level batch covariate.

hierarchy.description: Source of the cell-type hierarchy and of the resolutions used for stability.

source.description: Tree from clustering (tree_key) or from ordered author labels (annotation_keys).

tree_key.description: uns key of the cluster tree; required when source is cluster_tree.

annotation_keys.description: Coarse-to-fine obs columns, ordered; required when source is annotation_levels.

resolutions.description: Leiden resolutions in obs/leiden_res_<r>; at least two enable the stability output.

method.description: tasccoda on the hierarchy is the default; sccoda and propeller run on leaves as baselines.

fdr.description: Target FDR: posterior expected FDR for tasccoda and sccoda, Benjamini-Hochberg for propeller.

reference.description: Reference cell type with zero effect; used by tasccoda and sccoda only.

cell_type.description: Leaf with zero effect, or automatic to choose one with a low zero fraction.

absence_threshold.description: Maximum zero fraction allowed for an automatically chosen reference.

lambda_0.description: Spike penalty of the spike-and-slab LASSO prior on node effects.

lambda_1.description: Slab penalty of the spike-and-slab LASSO prior on node effects.

theta.description: Global spike-and-slab mixing weight, held fixed rather than sampled.

collapse_singular_nodes.description: Collapse nodes with a single child before fitting.

sccoda.description: Options for the sccoda leaf-level baseline.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Random seed for NUTS initialisation and draws.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without fitting.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: estimate only; queued: long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: For completed runs: method, n_leaves, n_nodes, reference, n_called, stability_mean, n_resolutions, warnings.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
